notes: Modified cash basis city, FYE 9/30/2022, extracted like FY2023/FY2024. The trimmed PDF lacks the asset/liability half of the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1 shows only the NET POSITION section: governmental 15,822,442, business-type 9,094,025, total 24,916,467). Balance sheet is therefore taken from the governmental funds Balance Sheet Total column (p6) plus the proprietary funds Statement of Net Position Totals column (pp13-14); totals are the sums of the two statements (computed). Governmental lines from the Total column of the governmental funds Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (pp7-12); transfers in/out from the Total column (net of the Adjustments column eliminations 1,512,433); sales tax and grant loan advances/repayments/recoveries are printed under Other Financing Sources (Uses) and go to other_financing. Business-type lines from the proprietary funds statement Totals column (pp15-16; measure net position); disbursement total 4,534,305 printed on the Statement of Activities (p2) = operating 4,509,930 + interest expense 24,375. Beginning and ending governmental cash null (no single cash total printed; Cash in Bank 7,740,678 and Cash at County Treasurer 44,511 listed separately on p6), as in FY2023. Grants 288,887 = 'Fedeal Receipts' on the budget schedule (p20), so federal. Detail: revenues and other financing per fund column of the governmental funds statement, expenditures from the Schedule of Expenditures by fund (pp22-23, object detail), business-type per fund from the proprietary statement. The combined Total Primary Government budgetary comparison schedule (pp20-21) and the electrical statistics (p24) are not recorded as detail. Public Health Fund objects cover public safety and public health; dominant function (public safety) used. Read pages 1-24 of 24
